verdict.rationale: Lium's own docs refer to "default templates" for pods, in the context of root access, Docker-in-Docker and encryption at rest, so the platform does ship pre-built pod environments. Nothing in the evidence says what those templates contain, and PyTorch, CUDA, vLLM and ComfyUI are never named. The Jupyter toggle is a related option rather than a template, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented template catalog naming PyTorch/CUDA/vLLM/ComfyUI images, docs on choosing a template at launch via CLI/API/UI, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
